confirmed_findings: Qoder cannot read /annotation/input.json outside /app under dont_ask permissions; both native final answers contain empty annotations and explain access failure.
GLM batch001 contains a single complete fenced JSON object after a preamble; strict JSON parser rejected it.
Source anchor validator rejected exact module-qualified names requested by the annotation instruction.
diagnostic_history.recovery_policy: Preserve every prior session; reparse existing valid complete OpenCode candidates and rerun only inaccessible Qoder candidate inputs; reviews generated with corrected annotation delivery.

candidate_recovery.reviews_policy: All semantic reviews are new; start after all candidate batches finish. Run three groups concurrently, batches within each group serially.
candidate_recovery.selection_policy: Reuse preserved eligible raw candidates with their prior status, hash and historical costs; no best-of candidate selection.
